stemMarkdown: The price of an article is increased by 20% and the new price is then decreased by 20%. Find the net percentage change in the price. (Enter a negative value for a net decrease.)
solutionMarkdown: Start from 100. After the increase: $100 \times (1 + 20/100) = 120.00$. After the decrease: $120.00 \times (1 - 20/100) = 96.00$. Net change $= -4.0\%$.
